caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular cloth situated centrally on a plain, off-white background. The cloth features a predominant area of deep purple and muted red tones toward its center, which are interwoven in a subtle, almost patchwork-like manner. Along the top border, the cloth has a wide horizontal band of pale blue-gray, while the right edge is bordered by a vertical strip in light beige and pale pink shades. The texture of the fabric is emphasized with visible soft creases and wrinkles, giving it a natural, slightly draped appearance. There are no other objects, patterns, or markings present in the drawing apart from the cloth and the unembellished background.
title: Shaker Silk Kerchief
